newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 28.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 28.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Placer Dome Inc said on Thursday morning from Vancouver that it planned to bid one Placer Dome share for every 15 Placer Pacific shares to mop up the remaining 24.6 percent stake it does not already own. Placer Dome's shares closed down 40 cents at C$32.90 on Wednesday. Placer Dome said it would also bid 75 cents per share cash for Highlands Golds shares.
Gambling machine operator Aristocrat Industries Ltd said on Wednesday that former AWA Ltd managing director John Dougall had been appointed executive chairman and chief executive officer.
* Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$17.94 (-0.01)
Coal miners in the Australian state of New South Wales are threatening to strike from later on Thursday because of a cut in accident compensation, a senior union official said on Thursday.
Uranium producer Energy Resources of Australia Ltd (ERA) said on Wednesday its first quarter net profit rose to A$600,000 compared to a loss of A$200,000 in the previous corresponding quarter.
